hero.heading: A Smarter Tomorrow for Every Farmer
hero.subheading: Plan the right crops, optimize your farm resources, and make informed agricultural decisions with AI.

features.title: Precision Agriculture Powered by Math & AI
features.subtitle: Moving beyond generic recommendations to mathematically optimal farm management plans.
features.card1_desc: Evaluates NPK, pH, soil texture, rainfall, and agro-climatic conditions using trained Random Forest models.
features.card2_desc: Formulates Linear Programming (PuLP) to allocate acreage respecting your exact water, fertilizer, and budget constraints.
features.card3_desc: Speak or type in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, or English with real-time ICAR advisory RAG.
features.card4_desc: Persistent knowledge base where farmer feedback undergoes expert agronomist verification before sharing.

workflow.title: How the Optimization Engine Works
workflow.step1_desc: Enter soil test parameters, available irrigation water, fertilizer stock, and budget.
workflow.step2_desc: ML models identify top suitable crops and estimate expected production per acre.
workflow.step3_desc: Solver computes feasible acreage distribution to maximize net profit or water savings.
workflow.step4_desc: Get downloadable PDF reports, resource schedules, and ROI comparisons.

assistant.title: Multilingual AI Agricultural Voice Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask questions about pests, fertilizer schedules, water management, or crop care in your mother tongue.
assistant.mic_denied: Microphone permission denied. You can type your question below.

assistant.feedback_prompt: Did this solution solve your problem?
assistant.feedback_thanks: Thank you! Your feedback helps update the verified knowledge base.

knowledge.title: Agricultural Knowledge Hub
knowledge.subtitle: Discover verified field solutions validated by ICAR agricultural scientists.

footer.desc: VELTRIX is an AI and Mathematical Linear Optimization System designed to empower farmers with science-backed, resource-efficient farm plans.
footer.disclaimer: Agricultural yields and returns are estimates based on standard regional agronomic baselines and solver algorithms. Weather, local pest outbreaks, and farm practices affect actual outcomes.
